summary: Verified print bug fix for AllergoLab report modal. Executed full flow: login as admin -> New Report -> filled patient (Mario Rossi, 1990-05-10) -> selected allergens f1 (Albume) and f2 (Latte) -> added to selection -> opened preview modal -> switched to media='print' and validated computed styles. All required print-mode conditions are satisfied and the printable content is fully rendered (not blank).
critical_code_review_comments: @media print rules in App.css correctly hide #root, [data-sonner-toaster] and .fixed.inset-0, and restore [role='dialog'] to static flow. The visible printable region uses id='allergolab-report'. This approach avoids the previous visibility:hidden-on-body issue that produced blank pages.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Print verification results with media='print' while ReportModal open: #root computed display=none; #allergolab-report display=block, visibility=visible, position=static; overlay div.fixed.inset-0 display=none; .no-print toolbar display=none; [role='dialog'] restored to static position. Report content in print includes patient name (Mario Rossi), Codici SISS section with code 0090681.00, Medico richiedente (Duilio Brugnoni), and exams f1/f2. Screenshot captured in print mode shows report rendered without blank space. After restoring media='screen', #root display=block and overlay/report render normally. Note: text search for 'Medico richiedente' returned False only due to CSS uppercase transform on the label (rendered as 'MEDICO RICHIEDENTE'); the label is present and visible in the print screenshot.
rca of the issue: Previous implementation used visibility:hidden on body descendants, which left layout space of the app -> blank printed pages. Fix sets display:none on #root and the Radix overlay (.fixed.inset-0), and normalizes [role='dialog'] to position:static so the portalized DialogContent (with id='allergolab-report') occupies the page. Confirmed working via page.emulate_media(media='print') + getComputedStyle assertions and full_page print-mode screenshot.
